Thought: To find the total electron count of NO, I need to:
1. Identify the elements in NO: Nitrogen (N) and Oxygen (O)
2. Find the atomic number of each element (which equals the number of electrons in a neutral atom)
3. Add them together to get the total electron count

Nitrogen (N) has an atomic number of 7, so it has 7 electrons.
Oxygen (O) has an atomic number of 8, so it has 8 electrons.

The total electron count of NO is 7 + 8 = 15 electrons.
